response.rationale: The acute onset of bilateral knee swelling and pain 12 hours after Synvisc injections, with high synovial fluid WBC counts but negative cultures and no systemic symptoms, strongly favors a post-injection inflammatory reaction. Septic arthritis is considered but less likely due to negative cultures and absence of fever. Crystal-induced arthritis and hemarthrosis are less supported by available data. The time course and negative cultures are decisive in ranking D1 first.
